raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was re-delivered at 2026-01-18 05:00 on top of its 02:00 load, so the same txn_ids appear twice in raw_transactions (5154 rows for 4827 distinct ids, and batch 13 has 654 rows versus about 340 for other batches). The silver step has no de-duplication, so every re-delivered transaction is double-counted in silver and in all gold tables built from it. Deduplicating on txn_id after the POSTED filter, keeping the earliest delivery, restores one row per transaction; the gold tables rebuild from silver, so only silver needs an override.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
